sources.title: Vintern-1B: An Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model for Vietnamese
sources.snippet: The model is fine-tuned on an extensive dataset of over 3 million image-question-answer pairs, achieving robust performance and reliable results across multiple Vietnamese language benchmarks like OpenViVQA [3]. Vintern-1B is small enough to fit into various on-device applications easily.
